hypothesis: 独立边界探针可发现固定前缀预算、重试上限和结果归因缺口
acceptance_criteria: 保留原始实现；运行既有测试并输出每个边界探针的实际结果；不得将脚本结果作为模型证据
command:
import copy,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from toolloop_fix.harness import run_case,tool_call
root=Path.cwd(); out=Path(sys.argv[1])
cases=[json.loads(x) for x in (root/"data/dev/pilot_cases.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
def fixture(domain="orders", category="recoverable"):
 return copy.deepcopy(next(x for x in cases if x["domain"]==domain and x["category"]==category))
check=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_harness.py","-v"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(check.stdout);print(check.stderr)
probes={"existing_harness_tests_exit_code":check.returncode}
r,t=run_case(fixture(),"scripted_naive","fixed_failure_prefix",tool_budget=12)
probes["fixed_budget"]={"configured_tool_budget":12,"prefix_attempts":r["prefix_tool_attempts"],"continuation_attempts":r["tool_attempts"],"actual_total_tool_actions":sum(e["action"].get("type")=="tool" for e in t["events"]),"budget_exhausted":r["budget_exhausted"]}
c=fixture(category="retry_required");c["hidden"]["transient_remaining"]=5
r,t=run_case(c,"scripted_reference","end_to_end")
probes["retry_cap"]={"documented_max_retries":2,"tool_attempts":r["tool_attempts"],"success":r["success"],"has_invalid_loop":r["has_invalid_loop"],"codes":[e["response"]["code"] for e in t["events"]]}
c=fixture(domain="jobs",category="retry_required");c["hidden"]["polls_remaining"]=5
r,t=run_case(c,"scripted_reference","end_to_end")
probes["poll_cap"]={"documented_max_polls":3,"actual_polls":sum(e["action"].get("tool")=="poll_job" for e in t["events"]),"success":r["success"],"has_invalid_loop":r["has_invalid_loop"]}
c=fixture(category="normal")
actions=[tool_call("ask_user",field="identifier"),tool_call("get_order",identifier="ORD-101"),{"type":"final","answer":"shipped","identifier":"ORD-101"}]
with patch("toolloop_fix.harness.scripted_policy",side_effect=actions):r,t=run_case(c,"scripted_reference","end_to_end")
probes["unnecessary_help"]={"codes":[e["response"]["code"] for e in t["events"]],"success":r["success"],"premature_abandonment":r["premature_abandonment"]}
c=fixture();c["fixed_prefix"]*=3
r,t=run_case(c,"scripted_reference","fixed_failure_prefix")
probes["inherited_loop"]={"prefix_length":3,"success":r["success"],"has_invalid_loop":r["has_invalid_loop"],"loop_flags":t["loop_flags"],"continuation_codes":[e["response"]["code"] for e in t["events"] if e["phase"]=="continuation"]}
(out/"review_probes.json").write_text(json.dumps(probes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(probes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
sys.exit(check.returncode)
